status: SIMULATED: a probe, not the expert set and not an evaluation result (B-D22). Written by Claude on 24 November 2026 at Tri's request, for the reasoning lane of specification 8.6 (experiment E34). No drilling expert has reviewed it. Frozen before any run of the lane with a real model: do not change a question or gold value because of a result; add a new version instead.
gold_source: Read by hand from the descriptions of AK-3's 28 non-productive events as the daily reports and the non-productive-time report (appendix 23) give them, in graphrag/results/E28_events.json. A stated cause is one the report's own words give. Nothing here is a drilling engineer's judgement.
known_limits: Ten questions on one well: the result is a demonstration to discuss with the expert group, not a score.

The gold lists only causes written in the event descriptions. A cause stated elsewhere in a report (a remark, the end-of-well report's narrative) and correctly cited would be counted as unsupported; read such rows by hand.

The chunks of each stated cause are left empty, so any kept citation is accepted: chunk IDs differ between the K1 version 0 export and K1 version 1, and the probe must run on either. Whether the cited passage really states the cause is read by hand.
Terms are matched as text, so a right cause in other words is missed, and a wrong sentence containing a term is accepted.
The questions were written by someone who had read the events, so their wording is closer to the reports than a real user's would be.

questions.question: What caused the stuck pipe on AK-3 on 20 August 2016?
Why was a core rod lost in the hole on AK-3 on 21 August 2016?
Why did the rig crews of AK-3 spend the night of 16 August 2016 at the lodge instead of on site?
What held up the spud of AK-3 on the morning of 18 August 2016?

stated_causes.cause: waiting on weather so the Mayor and the Priest could reach the site for a blessing

questions.question: Why was AK-3 circulating and waiting at 1,725 ft on 3 September 2016?

stated_causes.cause: waiting on weather to fly more core rod to the site; winds over 35 knots

questions.question: What was AK-3 waiting for on the morning of 5 September 2016?

stated_causes.cause: waiting on the well design after the review of the pressure and temperature data

questions.question: Why was no work done on AK-3 on 13 August 2016?
What caused the well control problem with code KICK on AK-3, and why did the well flow?

stated_causes.cause: the well kicked: hot water and steam flowed to surface from the hole at 176 ft
